dedupe_keys.name: cbs statline inland shipping freight statistics binnenvaart netherlands

description: Statistics Netherlands (CBS) publishes inland shipping (binnenvaart) freight statistics in its StatLine database. The table on arrivals and departures by country and type of goods (82515NED, 2007 to 2022) gives the transport performance of inland vessels on Dutch territory for international arrivals and departures, excluding domestic and transit transport: cargo weight carried, cargo tonne-kilometres and container units, split by country of origin or destination and by type of goods, as annual figures from 2007. Related StatLine tables cover inland shipping by transport flow and goods type, by type of load, monthly domestic and international freight back to 1996, and rail freight. Coverage is national. The tables are free under CC BY 4.0, listed on data.overheid.nl, and available through the CBS OData API and StatLine downloads. Caveats: this table was discontinued on 14 April 2023 and replaced by a successor table on the same subject; figures are final up to 2018 and provisional for 2019 to 2021. The freight flows support network flow and capacity planning models of the Dutch and Rhine inland waterway system and low-water resilience studies. It complements the 50-year Rhine-Alpine inland waterway freight record and the CBS airport statistics.
name: CBS StatLine inland shipping freight statistics (Binnenvaart), Netherlands
provider: Centraal Bureau voor de Statistiek (CBS), Netherlands
